question: What mean Raman shift did the V-O3-V mode near 483 cm^-1 show when the V2O5 film on NiTi was prestrained?
rendered:
The document "Tunable Mechanochemistry of Lithium Battery Electrodes" contains the answer.

Specifically, page 3, section "Raman Spectroscopy and X-ray Diffraction" states: 
"The Raman spectra of the strained films (see Supporting Information, Figure S8) do not indicate additional modes occurring due to imposed strains on the film."

However, it does state that the Raman spectra of the strained films show mean shifts in peak positions, Δω (ωStrained − ωUnstrained) cm^−1 of strain sensitive Raman modes.

On page 3, section "Raman Spectroscopy and X-ray Diffraction" it is stated that "We observed a mean red shift of ∼2 cm^−1 for V−O1 (∼997 cm^−1), ∼3.5 cm^−1 for V−O3−V (∼483 cm^−1), and ∼5 cm^−1 for V−O2 (∼708 cm^−1) and a mean blue shift of 1 cm^−1 for V−O2 (∼303 cm^−1) when the V2O5 film is prestrained."

The V-O3-V mode near 483 cm^-1 shows a mean red shift of ∼3.5 cm^−1.
